top_five.rationale: Closest SG analogue: SME Network Score blends traditional + alt data on thin-file SMEs, but scores default-probability not peer-reported conduct; the model we must out-cover on behaviour.
SGX-backed commercial bureau covering SG SMEs with payment history and litigation; UEN-keyed but bank/court-sourced, no peer-submitted conduct reviews — our direct white-space.
Global identity standard via D-U-N-S; the incumbent we benchmark identity-binding against, but PAYDEX is trade-line data not director-conduct or bad-faith dispute signal.
Authoritative UEN + director registry our identity layer must key to; provides who/what but zero behavioural reputation — the raw substrate we enrich, not a rival product.
SG network-graph due-diligence on ACRA data, surfaces related-party/phoenix patterns we also target — but graph inference only, no peer-sourced first-hand conduct reports.

strengths: De facto global business identifier accepted by govts and banks
weaknesses: PAYDEX measures trade-line payment timing not bad-faith disputes, NDA breach or director conduct
Thin first-party data on small SG private SMEs
